Test fixtures of internal/studio: public Wikimedia Commons photos, downscaled to 800 px
on the long side (JPEG q88), each with the cut-out mask the studio research spike made
for it (BiRefNet-general-lite + SAM 2.1 base-plus rescue union, 8-bit PNG, downscaled
with a box filter to the photo's size). No user photos are kept here.
